submitted.rationale: Highest measured photocurrent (3.94 µA) of 3 measurements. Photocurrent rose steadily with Fe content (V-rich 0.92 µA < Fe:V≈1 1.75 µA < Fe-rich 3.94 µA). Foundation-model gaps (~2.1–2.8 eV) only confirmed absorption at 3.2 eV and did not separate the compositions.

consultations.verdict: Support: MEGNet HSE gap 2.75 eV for the queried phase is below the 3.2 eV photon energy, consistent with FeVO4-type absorber; index 14 sits near Fe:V≈1:1 with modest Cr, a plausible FeVO4-based photoanode region.

Uninformative-to-mild support: PBE gap 2.08 eV (HSE 2.75) confirms a visible-absorbing vanadate reference, but does not discriminate composition; measuring V-rich index 37 to probe the V-rich gradient.

Uninformative for composition choice: SCAN gap 2.80 eV is consistent with absorption at 3.2 eV. Choice is driven by measured trend (V-rich 37 < Fe:V~1 14), so stepping toward Fe-rich at similar Cr (index 174).
